scene amibeachconfront1
: I’m his daughter...not his niece.

scene amibeachconfront2

scene amibeachconfront4

scene amibeachconfront5
Otoha hops off the banana boat and I am suddenly thrust into one more sentimental conversation that further delays all of the sex I am going to have today.
But...I want this more than that. And I feel sick to my stomach for even being able to think about sex right now when my daughter is within arm’s reach for the first time since she left.
Things like that come naturally when you’re conditioned, though. And I’ve been trained with one very specific thing in mind. To devour.

scene amibeachconfront8
I track down Imani on the way to the inn, assuming she’d have my key. Which she did. And she handed it over no questions asked after seeing who was with me.
I imagine Wakana told her since I didn’t.
But I don’t think that deeply into whether or not Imani feels somewhat betrayed or let down by this because I have someone else to be concerned about right now.
We make it here undetected after that — and find that the room has already been prepped with various welcoming gifts like sodas and snacks and things I likely won’t consume.
But among these things, there is one object that stands out — a folded sheet of paper with the word “Dad” handwritten across it in red ink.
: I asked the front desk if they could put that in here. Don’t read it now, though...it’s kind of embarrassing.

: Something like that.
: I’ve had too many...feelings lately. And I needed to do something with them before my body exploded.
scene amibeachconfront9

scene amibeachconfront18

scene amibeachconfront19

scene amibeachconfront20

scene amibeachconfront21
: I try not to care about pretty much anyone other than you, Dad. My feelings don’t matter, so they may as well not even exist.

: Because I’m not the protagonist. I’m the main heroine. And my feelings are little more than set-dressing to make your journey more fulfilling in the long run.

scene amibeachconfront22

scene amibeachconfront23
: I know! So I just won’t grow up then. That’s what you did, right? This way, I can stay your daughter forever and ever and things will be perfect! We don’t need another girl around.

if amifingered == True:

scene amibeachconfront24

scene amibeachconfront25
: Okay...sure. But say I do learn that. And I come to love Niki just as much as I love you. Maybe even more. Then what? What happens to us? What happens to you?
: Then, in turn, what happens to me when I lose both sight and grip of the single thing keeping me grounded? Everything changes. Everything falls apart. Everything is scary.
: I can’t...deal with scary. And you’re safe. So it’s my natural instinct to do whatever I can to preserve that. Niki was...a virus in the grand scheme of my perfect world.
: There is no perfect world, Ami. That’s not a thing.
scene amibeachconfront26
: Not yet, it’s not...
: But one day.
: One day, it’ll be reality. And it’ll be you and me...and everyone else who comes after, but never measures up.
: Sometimes, I think that’s the only place I can ever be happy. Which is why I...got all upset and angry and sort of...flipped out on you and said a bunch of stuff I didn’t mean.
: I’m...trying really hard, you know. In a lot of ways you won’t ever really understand. But I am. And so I...
: I ask you to overlook and...maybe forgive me if I ever do anything crazy. Which I probably don’t need to ask since I know you’ll do it anyway, just...I don’t know.

: Only because I’m the one beside you right now.
: If Ayane...or Maya...or even Chika was sitting here, I bet you’d tell them the same exact thing because it’s the easiest option. You don’t have to mean it to say it.

scene amibeachconfront27

scene amibeachconfront28

if amifingered == False:
